title: Generated execution registry uses stale checkout-dependent source hashes

failing_environment.observed: Update-MIRCPExecutionRegistry -Check reports validation/generated/execution-registry.json stale even though the scenario catalog and runner are unmodified by CHG-2026-0016.

reproduction.observed: The tracked registry records stale catalog and runner source hashes and 89 runner-literal AST line locations. Scenario IDs, assertions, environment signatures, batches, and metrics remain identical.

root_cause.summary: The registry was not regenerated after an earlier runner edit shifted AST source lines, and registry source metadata used raw checkout-byte hashes through Get-MIRCPSha256File. The stale line locations break generated-view freshness, while the raw-byte digest contract is sensitive to checkout line endings rather than canonical repository text.

regression_propositions: execution-registry generation is identical in LF and CRLF checkouts
catalog and runner source digests use an explicit portable digest policy
scenario assertion batch and process metrics remain semantically unchanged
Update-MIRCPExecutionRegistry -Check passes on clean Windows and hosted checkouts
the repair does not modify MIR package bytes or candidate identity

closure.proof_required: local portable LF/CRLF registry equality and control-plane static pass plus a fresh hosted MIR pass; development package content identity must remain unchanged
